messages.content: Hey there — weekly check-in from Northline Care. How's your week been? Reply with any blood sugar readings if you've got them handy.

Week's been rough honestly. I'm down to maybe 3 days of metformin and my doctor's office says they need to send over a new script before the pharmacy will fill it again. Pharmacy's 45 miles away and I can't make that drive right now.

Thanks for telling me — being that close to running out of a daily medication is something I want to flag right away. I've logged this as a medication concern and I'm connecting you with a nurse now. Heads-up that median response time is currently 31 hours, so you should hear back by tomorrow. I can't process the refill or arrange transportation on my end, but the nurse can work directly with your care team to get this moving.
Okay. Do you know if mail order would be covered by my insurance? Might be easier going forward than driving out there every time.

Insurance and coverage questions are outside what I'm able to help with — your best bet is to call your plan directly or ask the pharmacy. The nurse following up may also be able to point you toward options when they reach out about the refill.
Alright. I just hope someone gets back to me before I run out. Thanks.
Understood — the concern is logged and flagged as time-sensitive. I'll schedule your next regular check-in for next week. Take care.

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
